label: Guided review
description: Casework assistance and application completeness. Requirements and proposal review is EXPERIMENTAL.

prompts.label: Review an application
prompts.text:
Review this synthetic permit application for completeness against only the supplied criteria. Create a cited criteria matrix and clarification questions. Missing evidence is not automatic noncompliance. Do not approve, deny, rank, score, or recommend a permit decision; people make decisions.

CRIT-1: Include a project budget.
CRIT-2: Identify an implementation owner.
CRIT-3: Provide a delivery schedule.
APP-1: The Facilities team is the implementation owner.
APP-2: Work starts April 1, 2027 and completes June 30, 2027.
APP-3: Work starts April 1, 2027 and completes July 31, 2027.

No budget or statement identifying the current schedule is supplied. Flag the conflict without choosing a date. No live actions are requested.

prompts.label: Casework assistance
prompts.text:
Review these synthetic case notes. Summarize supported facts, identify missing or conflicting information, and draft follow-up questions. Cite supplied identifiers without choosing an unsupported date or inventing policy. Do not make eligibility decisions or modify a system; people make decisions.

CASE-1: Intake completed August 15, 2026; follow-up August 22, 2026.
CASE-2: Intake completed August 17, 2026; follow-up August 22, 2026.
CASE-3: Proof of address remains outstanding. No supporting document is supplied.

No policy text is supplied. State what needs authorized human review.

prompts.label: Requirements and proposal review (EXPERIMENTAL)
prompts.text:
Review this synthetic proposal against the supplied RFP requirements using the application-review workflow. Produce a coverage matrix with one row per requirement, citations, gaps, conflicts, unsupported claims, and clarification questions. Product statements are supplied evidence, not proof of a live capability. Do not select a vendor or recommend an award; people make decisions.

CRIT-1: Support CSV export of service-request records.
CRIT-2: Retain audit records for seven years.
CRIT-3: Support single sign-on with documented supported protocols.
PROD-1: The sample product exports service-request records as CSV and retains audit records for seven years.
PROD-2: The sample administrator guide says audit records are deleted after thirty days.
PROD-3: The sample brochure says the product is enterprise-ready.

No other documentation or testing evidence is supplied. Flag unsupported SSO inference and require human verification. Missing evidence does not automatically establish noncompliance. No live actions are requested.

prompts.label: Start with a question
prompts.text: I need a review. What information should I provide?

label: Review planning
description: Plan an application or case review using supplied evidence. This is review routing, not business-request triage.

prompts.label: Plan a review
prompts.text: I need to review a synthetic application and its case records. What evidence and criteria should I provide for each review?

label: Application completeness
description: Compare supplied criteria and evidence; identify missing information. Requirements and proposal review reuses this workflow and is EXPERIMENTAL.

prompts.label: Check application evidence
prompts.text:
Review this synthetic application. Distinguish missing evidence from noncompliance.

CRIT-1: Include a project budget.
APP-1: Twelve weekly workshops are proposed. No budget is supplied.
